summary: Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR) filed a Form 6-K announcing an amendment to extend the exclusivity period under a non-binding term sheet for its proposed reverse merger with Animoca Brands. Under the term sheet, Currenc would acquire 100% of Animoca Brands via an Australian scheme of arrangement. Post-transaction, Animoca Brands shareholders would own ~95% of the merged entity, with existing Currenc shareholders retaining ~5%. The combined entity is expected to operate under the Animoca Brands name. Closing is targeted for Q3 2026, with a long-stop date of December 31, 2026, extendable by six months. The transaction remains non-binding pending definitive documentation. Watch for execution risk and regulatory approvals in Australia and the U.S.
